display.title: The Iridescent Codex
display.subtitle: One pool. Four lanes. Your path.
description: Welcome, adventurer. The Iridescent Codex is your guide to power.
Your progress is measured in a SINGLE COMBINED POOL of progression
tokens. You fill it however you like, drawing from any of four lanes:
§6Exploration§r  - slay bosses, visit dimensions, find loot
Reach a tier threshold and you ascend. Mix lanes freely - the pool
never cares WHICH lane the tokens came from.
Right-click the Codex to read the full doctrine, then pick a lane.
Check your standing any time with §e/icraft codex balance§r.
